name: get_website_values
full_description: Returns available values for a website filter, including saved segments or cohorts when requested, to populate filter choices. Select a saved Umami host_id. Original upstream: GET /api/websites/{websiteId}/values.

host_id.description: Saved Umami connection ID. Obtain it from hosts_list.

startAt.description: Start of the date range as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

endAt.description: End of the date range as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

startDate.description: Start of the date range as an ISO 8601 date or date-time.

endDate.description: End of the date range as an ISO 8601 date or date-time.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to interpret dates and group results, for example America/New_York.

unit.description: Time interval used to group results: minute, hour, day, month, or year.

compare.description: Comparison period: prev for the previous period or yoy for the same period last year.

type.description: Type of resource or analytics dimension to return.

search.description: Search text used to filter results.
